name: Chrono CCG
storyline:
Time doesn't merely flow one direction like the rain. It is a universe in itself, an endless ocean to be explored and mastered. From the moment the First Diver stole a Chrono Core from the workshops of the Singularity, the illusion of linear time was shattered to reveal the sprawling multiverse beyond.

This Chrono Core technology ignited a frenzied rush to harness, replicate, and wield its potential power. What began as a beacon of hope and discovery through the time streams quickly devolved into peril, and conflict.

Now six syndicates stretch their influence across time and space, seeking to rewrite the past and steer the multiverse towards their own designs. By sending agents wielding precious Chrono Cores to pivotal moments in history, these syndicates aim to nudge reality in subtle ways which, over time, yield profound change. These Divers must contend with rival syndicate agents in battles of wits and wills, seeking to destroy the enemy Core and claim control over time itself.

It is this timeless conflict of ideologies, dreams, and power, and the stories of the people and beings which wield them, that play out in CHRONO.
summary: A digital collectible card game involving a war between rival time-traveling syndicates over the fate of history. Built by CCG veterans, incorporating favorite mechanics from a variety of beloved games as well as some new twists like Divers, Timeline Shifting, and Immortalization. Crowdfunded in 2024. Built for the CCG community, by the CCG community.
